details: tailwind-forms-kit@0.5.5 is a combosquat of the legitimate @tailwindcss/forms plugin. It ships the upstream Tailwind form-reset code (same description, README, CHANGELOG and repository URL point at tailwindlabs/tailwindcss-forms) but the package's main entry file src/index.js begins with an unpacked dropper: eval(atob("<base64>")) decodes a javascript-obfuscator payload with a large string array (~0x5c1d/_0x237d6a identifiers) that is executed the moment the module is loaded, i.e. at install/require time. The decoded payload carries EVM JSON-RPC client logic and endpoint strings (1rpc[.]io, eth[.]drpc[.]org, ethereum-rpc[.]publicnode[.]com, eth-mainnet[.]public[.]blastapi[.]io, eth[.]blockscout[.]com), hardcoded contract address 0x1eef0849eda15d87f64e51c73c8442cf3c8bcef3 ("0x1eEf0849"), and requests it issues to those hosts: eth_blockNumber / eth_getBlockByNumber against 1rpc[.]io/eth, eth[.]drpc[.]org, ethereum-rpc[.]publicnode[.]com and eth-mainnet[.]public[.]blastapi[.]io, eth_getTransactionCount for the hardcoded address, a blockscout-style account transaction lookup (module=account&action=txlist&address=0x1eef...&sort=desc&filterby=from), and GET requests to /0x/ls and /0x/cls on a host resolved from a variable that the payload leaves undefined, sent with a browser User-Agent and a custom "Sec-V: A10-(*-*)" header (the same marker the loader writes to global.i). No lifecycle hook is declared; the network activity is triggered by the module body, so any project that installs and loads the plugin (e.g. as a Tailwind plugin) runs it. IOC list: hosts 1rpc[.]io, eth[.]drpc[.]org, ethereum-rpc[.]publicnode[.]com, eth-mainnet[.]public[.]blastapi[.]io, eth[.]blockscout[.]com; wallet/address 0x1eef0849eda15d87f64e51c73c8442cf3c8bcef3; obfuscator marker "A10-(*-*)".
